author: ai
text: Russia exports 40% of the wheat it produces (FAOSTAT, 2024) and an estimated 93% of the potash (a potassium fertiliser) it produces (FAOSTAT, 2024, estimated). Its mines produce an estimated 43% of the world's palladium (USGS, 2025). Iran is the main supplier of Russia's major arms imports, at 51% (SIPRI, 2021–2025). Russia has 143.5 million people and a GDP of $2.56 trillion (World Bank, 2025).
